subject: SIG artifacts: artifact tracker + recent change-log submission
messages:
From: Alyssa Moss <alyssa.moss@nebula-bank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Sep 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: artifact tracker + change log for SIG review

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking time on the call earlier. As part of Nebula's SIG intake we're collecting an artifact tracker and the most recent change log for production-facing repos that touch inference runtime, CI/CD, and secrets rotation. Can you share the following items by EOD Friday?

- An artifact tracker listing: repo name, owner, PR gating policy, last deploy, and location of KMS/secret references.
- A short change-log (past 90 days) summarizing deploys that altered deployment gates, keystore rotation, or CI gating rules.
- CI run output for the deploy that introduced the latest gating changes (we only need the top-level job output, redacted tokens ok).
- Evidence of rotation for the KMS keys used in production within the last 12 months.

I can accept a single spreadsheet + a small PDF summary + log snippets. Also will need a signed attestation that these artifacts are accurate for our assessor.

Please let me know if you want us to accept partial items first and follow up with the rest.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Moss
Security Assessment Lead
Nebula Bank

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Moss <alyssa.moss@nebula-bank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Sep 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: artifact tracker + change log for SIG review

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks — attaching the artifact tracker spreadsheet and a short change-log PDF to get started. Attachments: SDLC_Artifact_Tracker_v1.xlsx (master tracker) and change-log-snippet-2029Q3.pdf (human-readable summary).

Quick notes:
- The tracker includes high-level repo rows called "infra-serving", "runtime-core", and "deployment-orch" with owners and gate types. We listed where KMS key references live (config repo and runtime secrets manifest).
- The change-log covers July–September 2029 deploys that changed gating rules; the most significant is the deploy on 2029-08-28 where we tightened the PR gating policy and introduced the ephemeral-kms policy.

I'm attaching the spreadsheet now; Karthik will follow up with CI output and the key rotation ops snapshot. We can provide a signed attestation PDF once you've confirmed these items are acceptable for the assessor.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SDLC_Artifact_Tracker_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: change-log-snippet-2029Q3.pdf (PDF)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Moss <alyssa.moss@nebula-bank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Sep 2029 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: artifact tracker + change log for SIG review

Alyssa — attaching CI job output and the brief KMS rotation ops snapshot.

What I'm including:
- ci-run-2029-08-28.log (top-level pipeline output for the 2029-08-28 deploy that exercised the new gating rules; token values redacted).
- kms-rotation-ops.txt (ops notes and rotation job history summary; includes KMS key identifiers and rotation timestamps).

A few clarifications inline:
- The CI run includes a short failing integration test that triggered a rollback of the canary step; that is documented in the log with job ids. The failure was unrelated to secret handling and a fix was merged the same day.
- KMS rotation: primary production key rotated 2029-02-14; we perform scheduled rolling rewraps every 90 days for ephemeral caches and keep a documented rotation ledger in the config repo (link in tracker).

If you need signed attestation now, Irene or I can sign attestation-sdlc-2029-09-14.pdf after you confirm the artifacts are sufficient.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ci-run-2029-08-28.log (log)
Attachment: kms-rotation-ops.txt (text)

From: Alyssa Moss <alyssa.moss@nebula-bank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: sig-assessments@nebula-bank.com
Date: Sat, 14 Sep 2029 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: artifact tracker + change log for SIG review

Irene / Karthik — this is great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. The assessor logged the tracker and log snippets today and they're sufficient for the initial intake. A couple of small asks before we close the ticket:

1) Can you add a single column in the tracker indicating "gating rationale" (one sentence) for the rows that changed Sept–Aug 2029? That helps the assessor map risk to control.
2) Please provide the signed attestation PDF with a date and title (Irene or Karthik is fine to sign).

If you can drop those two items by EOD Monday we'll mark the SIG intake as complete and move to the next assessment queue.
